name: journey-tui-web-fastapi
description: Build the journey-tui-web backend: a tiny Python FastAPI app that serves a static sidebar+iframe page, binds the motor in-process, and manages ONE ttyd child (tmux attach) switched via tmux switch-client. Distilled from the FastAPI official lifespan docs + the zhanymkanov/fastapi-best-practices conventions, grounded in the locked v1 sketch.
